title: Early Experience: Data Construction + Dual-Branch Training (IWM & SR)

nodes.label: Expert Dataset D_expert
nodes.semantic_desc: Expert demonstrations consisting of state-action pairs (s_i, a_i); provides expert states for candidate sampling and expert actions for supervised training targets.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder labeled 'D_expert' with small rows showing '(s_i, a_i)' examples.

nodes.label: Initial LLM Policy
nodes.semantic_desc: Pretrained/initial LLM-based policy; takes state s_i (as text/representation) and outputs an action distribution used to sample non-expert candidate actions.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle module labeled 'Initial LLM Policy (π_0)' with a small transformer icon.

nodes.label: Candidate Action Sampler
nodes.semantic_desc: Sampling module; takes each expert state s_i and the initial policy output distribution and samples K alternative non-expert actions {a_i^1...a_i^K}.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Sample K Alternatives' with a small fan-out glyph indicating K samples.

nodes.label: Environment Rollouts
nodes.semantic_desc: Environment execution process; takes (s_i, a_i) and (s_i, a_i^j) and returns corresponding next/future states s_{i+1} and s_i^j.
nodes.visual_desc: Hexagon (environment symbol) labeled 'Env' with two small input arrows and next-state icons.

nodes.label: Future-State Signals
nodes.semantic_desc: Collected future states used as reward-free supervision; aggregates s_{i+1} from expert actions and s_i^j from sampled actions for comparison and prediction targets.
nodes.visual_desc: Two stacked state cards labeled 's_{i+1}' and 's_i^j' with a bracket indicating 'supervision'.

nodes.label: Rollout Dataset D_rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Rollout triples (s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j) built from executing sampled actions; serves as training data for implicit world modeling.
nodes.visual_desc: Dataset cylinder labeled 'D_rollout' with a row example '(s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j)'.

nodes.label: IWM Branch
nodes.semantic_desc: Implicit World Modeling training branch; takes (s_i, a_i^j) from D_rollout and trains the LLM policy to predict the corresponding future state s_i^j as a next-token prediction problem.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle labeled 'IWM: Predict Future State' with a small 'token' strip icon.

nodes.label: NLL Loss (Dynamics)
nodes.semantic_desc: Negative log-likelihood loss for state prediction; takes predicted future-state tokens and ground-truth s_i^j tokens and outputs a scalar training objective for IWM.
nodes.visual_desc: Small pill-shaped node labeled 'NLL' with a sigma/loss icon.

nodes.label: Expert vs Candidate Comparator
nodes.semantic_desc: Comparison module for self-reflection; takes paired outcomes (s_{i+1} from expert action, s_i^j from candidate action) and forms a contrast signal that expert is better.
nodes.visual_desc: Diamond (decision/comparison) labeled 'Compare Outcomes' showing two state cards on left and a '>' symbol.

nodes.label: SR Branch (Explanation Gen)
nodes.semantic_desc: Self-Reflection generation; takes (s_i, a_i^j) plus comparison context and outputs natural-language critique/explanation c_i^j stating why the expert action is preferable.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle labeled 'SR: Generate c_i^j' with a chat-bubble icon.

nodes.label: Reflection Dataset D_refl
nodes.semantic_desc: Reflection pairs/triples (s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j); provides supervised targets for generating self-reflection text conditioned on state and candidate action.
nodes.visual_desc: Dataset cylinder labeled 'D_refl' with a row example '(s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j)'.

nodes.label: Joint Supervised Training
nodes.semantic_desc: Unified training stage; takes D_expert and D_refl and updates the LLM policy to output expert actions a_i and reflections c_i^j (multi-task / joint objective).
nodes.visual_desc: Large rounded rectangle labeled 'Joint Training (Action + Reflection)' with two output ports.

nodes.label: Updated LLM Policy
nodes.semantic_desc: Trained policy after Early Experience; outputs improved action predictions (aligned with expert) and optionally self-reflection text, internalizing environment dynamics via IWM.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Updated Policy (π)' with a transformer icon and a small upward arrow indicating improvement.
